method.architecture: Unchanged provenance-scoped offering +33-parameter weighted domestic hierarchy; priors unchanged. Both stages use a new epsilon-insensitive practical-similarity loss.
method.semantics: Strict squared hinge and retained exact-equality squared-zero loss unchanged. Similarity loss=max(0,abs(m)-radius)^2, permits either sign and nonzero gaps inside band. Similar rows never generate hard equality constraints. No unresolved targets fitted. Known slight direction remains strict; broad practical qualification metadata does not invent an extra numerical bound.
method.radius: Inherited same per-fold threshold as model-scale similarity radius(0.15–0.5); full fit0.2. This is a declared modeling convention, not user-supplied monetary tolerance, and six similar pairs cannot establish a calibrated general tolerance.
method.prediction: Separate score direction, numerical equality, and within-similarity-band flags. Direction and similarity may coexist. Unresolved is an evidence state, not an implemented abstention predictor.
method.validation: Same401 rows/order/families as v11,5 outer folds x5 seeds. V11 control trained on prior labels; v12 candidate on clarified labels. Base offering settings inherited; prior strength selected on grouped inner-training semantic compatibility, balancing strict-direction/exact-equality/practical-similarity recalls. Baseline original margins and radii reproduced within1e-10. Six similarity rows are sparse and heavily influence a macro metric; report counts and per-type recalls.
method.reporting: Semantic compatibility is set-valued, not four-class accuracy. Exact equality requires abs(m)<=1e-7; strict direction uses sign with same tolerance; similarity accepts either sign including zero within declared radius. Separately report legacy band diagnostic on395 determinate labels, where band ties are not proof of exact equality. Do not compare headline percentages directly with prior401-row three-class accuracy.
method.limits: Repeated adaptive evidence, no fresh prospective validation. Only two revisited records updated; other equality labels not blanket reinterpreted. No peer-session interaction or baseline promotion.
